M-XG-002 · Platt and isotonic calibrators

Map raw probabilities to calibrated probabilities.

Method. Platt: in-house logistic on logit(p) (400 iters, lr 0.05, l2 0.001), needs >=10 rows and both classes. Isotonic: pool-adjacent-violators on predictions sorted ascending, blocks store max prediction & mean label; predict = first block whose maxPrediction >= p (step function, no interpolation); above last block -> last block mean.

Output. probability 0-1

M-XG-003 · Calibration requirement and cross-validated method selection

Decide whether post-calibration is needed and pick raw/Platt/isotonic.

Method. Requires post-calibration if |mean pred - goal rate| >= 0.02 or any 10-equal-width-bin gap >= 0.10 (bins with >=5 rows). Folds = min(5, max(2, positives)), stratified round-robin by sorted rowId. Compare raw vs CV Platt vs CV isotonic by log loss then Brier. Calibrator fit on VALIDATION split only, then applied to all splits.

Output. probability 0-1

M-XG-004 · xG offline challengers (LightGBM / CatBoost / XGBoost) with Platt calibration

Benchmark gradient-boosted xG challengers against the frozen logistic baseline

Method. LightGBM 200 trees lr 0.05 leaves 31 min_child 50 subsample/colsample 0.9 lambda 1; CatBoost depth 6 lr 0.05 l2_leaf 3; XGBoost depth 4 min_child_weight 5 lr 0.05 hist; seed 42+familyIndex; Platt = logistic on logit(p) with C=1e6, needs >=20 val rows and >=10 of each class; also per-strength-state models if train>=1000 rows and >=25 pos/neg; metrics Brier, log loss, AUC, ECE with 10 equal-width bins; probs clipped 1e-7

Output. probability 0-1; ECE 0-1

M-XG-005 · Power-play age and shift-fatigue features

Seconds into current PP and shift ages/gaps for shooter and on-ice units.

M-XG-007 · Shot coordinate normalization to attacking direction

Mirror raw NHL x,y so every shot attacks the net at (+89,0).

Method. attackingSide = home: opposite of homeTeamDefendingSide; away: = homeTeamDefendingSide. If attacking 'left', normalizedX=-x and normalizedY=-y (180-degree rotation), else unchanged. Net fixed at x=89 ft, y=0. No rink/arena bias adjustment.

Output. feet, attacking +x

M-XG-009 · Rebound shot definition and rebound geometry

Flag shots that follow a same-team shot attempt within 3 s and measure displacement.

Method. isReboundShot = immediately previous event (no intervening events allowed) is an eligible SOG/missed/blocked attempt by the SAME owner team, same period, and 0 < dt <= 3 s. Geometry: lateral displacement |dY|, distance delta (cur-src), angle change |dAngle|, distance from source (raw), speed = dist/dt.

M-XG-010 · Rush shot definition

Flag non-rebound shots preceded within 10 s by a qualifying turnover/faceoff/block in the shooting team's D or N zone.

Method. Scan backward up to 10 s (same period, dt>0). Qualifying sources: own takeaway, own faceoff win, opponent giveaway, opponent-owned blocked-shot. Source zone converted to shooting-team-relative (invert O/D for opponent events); rush if relative zone is D or N. Break on stoppage/penalty/period events, any other shot, opponent takeaway/faceoff, own giveaway. Rebound shots are never rush. Distance from source uses raw coords.

Output. boolean; seconds; feet; ft/s

M-XG-013 · Shot distance and angle

Euclidean distance (ft) and absolute angle (deg) from normalized shot location to net.

Method. distance = sqrt((89-x)^2 + (0-y)^2); angle = atan2(|y|,|89-x|)*180/pi (0 = straight on, 90 = goal line). Shots from behind the net (x>89) get the same angle as mirrored front shots because abs(89-x) is used.

Output. distance feet 0..~190; angle degrees 0..90

Turn shot feature rows into numeric design matrices for the shot_goal and rebound_creation models.

M-XG-019 · Binary logistic regression trainer (in-house gradient descent)

Fit the production shot-goal model (logistic_l2) and calibrators.

Method. Full-batch gradient descent from zero weights/bias: grad = sum(error*x*w)/totalWeight; update w -= lr*(grad + l1*sign(w) + l2*w); bias unpenalized. Defaults: 800 iterations, lr 0.05. Families: logistic_unregularized (l1=0,l2=0), logistic_l2 (l2=0.01), logistic_elastic_net (l1=0.001,l2=0.01). Output clipped to [1e-9, 1-1e-9]. No convergence check.

Output. probability 0-1

M-XG-020 · Python challenger models (LightGBM / CatBoost / XGBoost, global and per-strength)

Offline challengers against the champion artifact's exact dataset contract.

Method. M-XG-023 · xG-adjusted player impact (shot-level ridge, 'RAPM-like')

Estimate one coefficient per skater for on-ice xG differential with teammate/opponent and context controls.

Method. One design row PER SHOT (no rows for shot-free time). Response = shot xG (response_xg_differential = xg, always >=0). Shooting-team skaters coded +1, opponents -1 (goalies removed), single coefficient per player (offense and defense pooled). Context: is_home +/-1, period_seconds/1200, owner score diff, rest-day diff, one-hot strength_state, strength_exact, score bucket, zone_code, shot_zone_code. Fit: full-batch GD on squared error, intercept init = mean response, 500 iterations, lr 0.03, L2 0.1 on player and context weights; minPlayerRows=100 (route default). SE approx = sqrt(MSE / player rows).

Output. regression coefficient in xG-per-shot units

M-XG-059 · xG model specification as trained (includes / excludes)

Record exactly what the in-house shot xG model uses, per the trainer defaults and saved artifacts

Method. INCLUDES (first_pass_v1 preset, the one in both saved logistic_l2 artifacts): normalizedX/normalizedY (raw x,y mirrored by -1 when attacking toward negative side, using homeTeamDefendingSide; net at x=89,y=0), shotDistanceFeet, shotAngleDegrees = atan2(|dy|,|dx|) in degrees (unsigned, so no left/right side), shotType (categorical), strengthState + strengthExact (categorical), zoneCode, previousEventTypeDescKey, previousEventSameTeam, timeSincePreviousEventSeconds, distanceFromPreviousEvent, east-west/north-south movement feet, isReboundShot (3 s window), isRushShot (10 s window), isFlurryShot (5 s gap), crossedRoyalRoad, isEmptyNetEvent, isOvertimeEvent, period/periodSeconds/gameSeconds, ownerPowerPlayAgeSeconds, shooterShiftAgeSeconds. Optional presets: expanded_v2 adds score differential (home/away/owner + ownerScoreDiffBucket), possession chain counts/duration/start type, defenseman shooter, roster position, late-game close/trailing; speed_context_v3 adds speed-from-previous-event and rebound/rush speeds. Trainer also enriches shooter handedness, goalie catch hand and handedness matchup, and on-ice deployment context. EXCLUDES: score state in default preset (only in expanded_v2), shooter identity/talent effects, goalie identity/quality effects, rink-bias (arena) adjustment, pre-shot pass/royal-road beyond crossedRoyalRoad flag, post-event fields (shotEventType, missReasonBucket, isShortSideMiss are forbidden). TRAINING SET: single season 20252026 (default --season), 70/15/15 chronological game split: train 2025-10-07..2026-03-03 (82,636 shots), validation 2026-03-03..03-30 (17,829), test 2026-03-30..05-21 (17,834, includes playoffs). MODEL TYPE: default CLI family xgboost_js, but saved candidates are logistic_l2 (800 iters, lr 0.05, l2 0.01, train-only z-scored numerics, one-hot categoricals). CALIBRATION: validation-fit post-calibration chosen by lib/xg/calibration (corrected candidate: raw; approval run: isotonic)

Output. probability 0-1 per shot

M-FRG-022 · FORGE v2 refresh cadence and material-event coalescing

Plan when FORGE v2 player-game forecasts are reissued (daily, pregame, material events), capped at game lock, and track horizon episodes.

Method. lock = min(scheduled start, accepted lock). Daily job: deadline = min(08:00 America/New_York, found DST-safely as 12:00 or 13:00 UTC, lock), ready = min(now, deadline). Pregame: ready = deadline = min(start − 30 min, lock). Material event: ready = min(received + 5 min, deadline, lock − 1 ms), deadline = min(received + 15 min, lock). Pending unissued material jobs for the same target are coalesced, taking the minimum of lock/deadline/ready (≤1000 events). Scopes are capped at 100,000. Claim slots = min(batchSize, concurrency − running). A horizon episode number increments when a player-game re-enters the same horizon; episodes close when the horizon changes.

Output. timestamps

M-FRG-066 · Player uncertainty Monte Carlo (p10/p50/p90)

M-FRG-089 · FORGE v2 operational health summary and alarms

Summarize FORGE v2 operations (latency, source age, missingness, queue, outcome lag, qualification drift) against approved limits and estimate retention size.

Method. Alarms: limits missing; source age (now − observedAt) > maximumSourceAgeMs; pending > maximumQueued; retries = Σ max(0, attempts − 1) > maximumRetries; outcome lag ((settled ? recordedAt : now) − endedAt) > maximumOutcomeLagMs; qualification drift (decision unavailable or scope hash changed); integrity incidents. Publication latency is reported as mean and maximum. Missingness = count of unavailable means per category, plus opportunities without a publication. health = blocked if any alarm; readyForActivation is always false. Retention estimate: rows = scopes × dailyRevisions × days; bytes = rows × canonical-JSON bytes of a sample.

Output. ms, counts, bytes; categorical health

M-FRG-090 · FORGE v2 qualification gate (serving eligibility of means and participation)

Decide whether a vintage's category means and participation probability can be served publicly under a qualified manifest.

Method. Scope: horizons must be contiguous 1..k with k <= 10. Categories must be valid and include every non-zero DEFAULT_SCORING category. The default profile, participationQualified, and interval levels 0.5 and 0.9 are required, as is a hashed joint generator. Scope is full_v2 iff 10 horizons and all 7 categories, else contiguous_subset. Vintage must be public_serving, share target/conditioning/model/feature/code versions with the manifest, have a supported horizon and cohort, and use scoring rule 'linear-seven-v1'. Every contributing category must be available. Four evidence records must have matching hashes and scope digest, be approved, passed and independent with author != reviewer, and be in chronological order. The final evaluation must be untouched, with a sample manifest different from the prospective one, and review issued after both evaluations. qualifiedMeans masks unqualified categories; participation must be a finite value in [0,1].

Output. categorical decision; participation probability 0-1

M-FRG-093 · Goalie shots-against projection

Expected shots against from opponent skater shots, team defence history, trends, rest and venue

Method. blended = 0.65*oppProjShots + 0.35*teamSA10 + clamp(0.25*(SA5-SA10),±3); base = blended*(1+teamStrength.shotsAgainstPct). contextPct = 0.45*clamp((oppShots5-base)/base,-0.12,0.18) + 0.35*clamp((oppG5-oppG10)/oppG10,-0.1,0.15) + 0.03 if opp rest>=2 - 0.04 if opp B2B + 0.02 if defending B2B + 0.02 opp home / -0.01 opp away + 5v5 context + NST danger; clamp -0.15..0.2. SA = base*(1+contextPct).

Cutoff-safe per-player assist/hit feature vector (career, seasons, last-20, EWMA, team/opponent context)

M-PFC-006 · Deterministic Gaussian copula simulation for season quantiles

Draws joint samples of all v4+v5 targets to produce reconciled p10/p50/p90

Method. LCG (1664525, 1013904223) Box-Muller normals seeded by SHA-256; one common factor with correlation 0.65 for every target pair; value = mean + sd*(0.65*common + sqrt(1-0.65^2)*idio), clipped >=0; GP/GS capped at components (ROS) or 84; GA capped at SA; each draw reconciled; 256 draws; nearest-rank quantiles

Sum per-game means/variances to remaining-season totals and quantiles.

Method. Unconditional: mean += p*mu; var += p*sigma^2 + p(1-p)*mu^2 (Bernoulli mixture). Conditional: plain sums. Independence across games. Quantiles p10/p25/p50/p75/p90 = max(0, mean + z*sd) with z = -1.2816, -0.6745, 0, 0.6745, 1.2816. fullSeason = seasonToDateActual + remaining.

Output. remaining-season count totals, variance, quantiles p10-p90 (floored at 0)

M-PFC-064 · Contribution resolver: detailed/baseline blend and unconditional mean

Pick or blend detailed (FORGE) and baseline rates per player-game-target and multiply by participation probability.

Method. lead = UTC-day difference (game - now). Detailed excluded if lead >= horizon. If both valid and compatible (same unit/basis/integration): w = clamp((horizonDays - lead)/7, 0, 1); mean = w*detailed + (1-w)*baseline (so detailed only for lead <= horizon-7, linear fade over last 7 days). unconditionalMean = conditionalMean * participationProbability (1 if participationIntegrated). Falls back to baseline when detailed lacks participation. Exclusion reasons: stale, future_input, identity_conflict, outside_horizon, use_not_approved, etc.

Output. expected count/minutes per game (unconditional) and conditional mean; blend weight 0-1

M-PFC-118 · Season projection draft validation gates

Block a season projection release whose schedule shape, rosters, expected games/starts, derived stat identities, quantiles or role probabilities are invalid.

Method. Contract checksum must match the supported contract. Schedule must have exactly 1344 games, 32 teams with 84 games each. Each non-waived team needs at least 12 F, 6 D and 2 G. expectedGames must be in [0,84], and goalie expectedStarts in [0, expectedGames]. The required primitive targets for the contract (v4 fantasy / v5 advanced batches) must be finite. Each published value must equal its reconciled identity (e.g. SAVES = SA − GA, SV% = saves/SA, GAA = 3600·GA/TOI_seconds) within a relative tolerance of 1e-6·max(1,|a|,|b|). p10 <= p50 <= p90 for every target. Each role-probability family must have values in [0,1] that sum to 1 within the same tolerance.

Output. list of issue codes (pass/fail gate)

M-PFC-119 · Season roster consensus and roster_confidence ladder

Decide a player's organization and roster status from official observations (two-source agreement) and assign the roster_confidence that feeds the season projection model.

Method. Take the latest non-superseded observation per kind. Fewer than 2 official kinds → review_required, confidence = that single source's confidence (or 0). Distinct teams, or unsigned plus a team → review_required, confidence = max. Automatic only when roster+landing agree on a team, or landing+transaction agree (team, or both unsigned); then confidence = min of the agreeing pair, with roster status from the pair (disagreement → review, max). Observation confidence bands: official transaction = clamp(conf, 0.9, 1), default 0.95; other evidence = clamp(conf, 0, 0.89), default 0.75. roster_confidence = consensus.confidence when automatic, 1 when manually resolved, otherwise the prior value or 0.4. Pool-status default is 0.7 if verified_active, else 0.4. Roster and transaction data count as stale after 36 h.

Output. confidence 0-1; categorical resolution

M-PFC-128 · Play and start probability (participation shrinkage)

Estimates per-game appearance and start probability for every pool player

Method. population prior = median over player-seasons of min(1, appearances/82) (fallback 0.8 skater, 0.4 goalie; starts 0.0/0.3); play_probability = (appearances + k*prior)/(82*seasons_appeared + k) clipped [0.05,0.995]; start_probability same, capped at play probability; rookies with translation: expectedNhlGames/84 clipped [0.01,0.995]

Output. probability 0.05-0.995 per game

M-PFC-168 · EXPECTED_GOALS_AGAINST_GOALIE forecast

Named in-house forecast head. Per-game conditional rate from fitted portable artifact, context-adjusted and participation-integrated by evaluator; aggregates sum game means. GAMES_PLAYED and GAMES_STARTED use conditional value 1 with play/start probability.

Method. Expected total = sum of the eligible game means. For a conditional count, each game mean is its context-adjusted rate × the corresponding participation probability. Named in-house forecast head. Per-game conditional rate from fitted portable artifact, context-adjusted and participation-integrated by evaluator; aggregates sum game means. GAMES_PLAYED and GAMES_STARTED use conditional value 1 with play/start probability.

Output. Per-game / season / ROS mean in expected goals; associated variance and quantiles.

Inputs. Fitted conditional rate/variance; player participation; team/opponent/venue/rest context. Input units: expected goals.

M-RSO-025 · DUST daily lineup assignment (min-cost max-flow)

Assign a day's scheduled roster players to active slot instances, maximising starts then player value.

Method. Bipartite graph source->player(cap1,cost0)->eligible slot(cap1,cost -value)->sink. Successive shortest augmenting paths with Bellman-Ford (EPSILON 1e-10) until no path: maximum cardinality first, then minimum cost (max total value) among max-cardinality matchings. Non-finite value -> 0 with warning. Players/slots sorted by id for deterministic ties; benched = valid players unmatched; invalid-eligibility players are 'unresolved' and excluded.

Output. integer counts of started/benched player-games per day

M-RSO-039 · Streaming chain window DP (1 vs 2 spots)

Build day-by-day add/drop chains that spend the period's adds for most added active games, then points.

Method. Daily leagues only. budget = floor(period.remaining / acquisitionCost), one acquisition period. Per drop: capacity gain per day = maxMatch(with player) - maxMatch(without). Windows [start,end): candidate plays on days with gain>0 (first day only if claim before puck drop); ranked list top 12. DP best[start][used] = max over end of leg(ranked[0]) + best[end][used+1] (last leg held to end); value compares min(need, starts), then (pointsFirst) points, then games, then points, then fewer adds (1e-9 tolerance). Subtract dropped player's lost games/points/starts from start. Singles: first 3 drops always, more while work <= 2,000,000 and before deadline. Pairs: top 4 single drops, all splits of budget, second spot on top of first. Two-spot recommended only if it beats one-spot.

Output. chains with netGames integer, netPoints/netScore fantasy points

M-RNK-017 · Results Luck Index (component-aware, written)

M-RNK-027 · Player impact ratings (skater offense/defense, goalie) — z-score composite with TOI shrinkage

Season-to-date 0-100 impact ratings for skaters (offense, defense) and goalies from NST game logs.

Method. Per player, TOI-weighted mean of per-game per-60 rates over all game rows <= snapshot. Components z-scored across all players (population SD; missing -> z=0). Offense = 0.24 P/60 + 0.16 G/60 + 0.12 A1/60 + 0.16 ixG/60 + 0.10 SOG/60 + 0.08 iCF/60 + 0.08 oiXGF/60 + 0.06 (oiXGF%-50). Defense = 0.24 -oiXGA/60 + 0.14 -oiCA/60 + 0.12 -oiSCA/60 + 0.16 (oiXGF%-50) + 0.12 (oiCF%-50) + 0.10 blocks/60 + 0.08 (TK-GV)/60 + 0.04 DZS/60. Goalie = 0.50 GSAA/60 + 0.28 SV% + 0.12 QS% + 0.10 -GA/60. Raw x shrink factor TOI/(TOI+k), k=3600 s skaters, 2400 s goalies. rating_0_to_100 = ordinal percentile 100*(1 - index/(N-1)).

Output. 0-100 ordinal percentile; raw weighted z-score

M-RNK-034 · Team unit TOI builder (5v5 lines/pairs and PP units, pooled player-seconds)

Derive per-game forward-line, defense-pair and PP-unit TOI and shares from raw shifts.

Method. Per game-period, split time at every shift boundary; a segment is 5v5 if both teams have exactly 5 skaters (F or D) on ice; only exact 3F+2D configurations counted. Unit seconds = segment duration x player count (pooled player-seconds); units are exact player sets ranked by pooled seconds -> unit_number 1..k. Coverage partial if any skater has an unclassified position. PP: unit from powerPlayCombinations, pool = sum of PPTOI across all PP players; unit seconds = sum of its players' PPTOI. unit_share (DB generated) = unit_toi_seconds / team_unit_pool_toi_seconds.

Output. seconds; share fraction 0-1

M-SUS-016 · Rookie / low-trial prior strengthening fallback

Inflate prior strength for players with few historical trials so they lean further on the position league mean.

Method. Threshold T per stat: shp 100, oishp 150, ipp 40, ppshp 25 trials. If n<T: missingShare=(T-n)/T; boostedK=(alpha0+beta0)*(1+missingShare) (max 2x); keep mu=alpha0/K; re-derive alpha0,beta0 via betaFromMuK.

History seasons = three completed seasons before current (seasonId-10001 offsets). blendCounts: s_blend=sum(w_i*s_i), n_blend=sum(w_i*n_i) with fixed w=[0.6,0.3,0.1] most-recent first, NOT renormalised when seasons missing. Rookie fallback applied first (see separate entry). Posterior alpha=alpha0+s, beta=beta0+(n-s); post_mean=alpha/(alpha+beta); post_var=ab/((a+b)^2(a+b+1)). If n<=0 returns prior. Mixed-position players forced to F.

Output. Beta posterior; post_mean fraction 0-1

M-SUS-029 · Gamma / Beta / Normal trend band (value, CI, z, percentile)

Per player/metric/window: decayed EWMA, shrunk value, 80% band, pseudo-z and band percentile.

Method. Take first N samples. Gamma: decayed counts/minutes, ewma=60*Σwc/Σwe; value=blend(ewma,baseline,nEff=Σwe minutes,k=prior); prior shape0=baseline/60*k+1e-3, rate0=k+1e-3; CI = gamma 10/90% quantiles*60. Beta: ewma=Σws/Σwt; value=blend(n=Σwt); alpha0=baseline*k+0.5, beta0=(1-baseline)*k+0.5; CI beta 10/90%. Normal: ewma=Σwv/Σw; var=max(Σwv²/Σw-ewma²,1e-4); margin=1.28155*sd/max(sqrt(Σw),1); value=blend. z=(value-baseline)/((upper-lower)/(2*1.28155)); percentile=clamp(10+80*(value-lower)/(upper-lower),0,100).

Output. metric units; z dimensionless; percentile 0-100

M-SUS-036 · Beta-binomial empirical-Bayes window z (eb_z)

Standardise a window rate against the player's (or league) Beta baseline using beta-binomial predictive variance.

Method. strength=a+b; priorMean=a/strength; priorVar=ab/(strength^2(strength+1)); p_hat=s/n; shrink=strength/(strength+n); varMixed=priorMean(1-priorMean)(strength+n)/(n(strength+1)) [beta-binomial predictive variance of s/n]; z=(p_hat-priorMean)/max(sqrt(varMixed),sqrt(1e-9)). n=0 -> z=0. Non-finite outputs replaced by 0 before persist. Rounded z to 6dp.

Output. z-score (unbounded here; clipped ±3 downstream)

M-SUS-040 · Legacy NST career averages (unweighted mean of season rows)

M-SUS-043 · trendsDebug sustainability-model feature engineering (recent-vs-career z-like, aggregate delta, usage delta) and demo model

Admin debug page derives features from a rolling-metric row and feeds lib/sustainability/model (probabilities, score, count projections) using an in-page demo-trained model.

Method. usageDelta = (toiRecent - toiCareer)/|toiCareer|; aggregateDelta = mean of pct-changes of shots/60, ixG/60, PP share (last5 vs career); zLike = mean of (shotsRecent-shotsCareer)/max(0.2*shotsCareer, 0.4) and (ixgRecent-ixgCareer)/max(0.2*ixgCareer, 0.08); recent per-60 for counts = avg per-game count (last5)*3600 / avg TOI seconds (last5), default TOI 900 s if missing. Features [shots/60, ixG/60, PP TOI pct, usageDelta, PDO] go to predictSustainabilityProbabilities(DEMO_MODEL); DEMO_MODEL trained in-page (900 iterations, lr 0.12, 350 calibration iterations) on 6 hand-written z-scale vectors (2 cold, 2 normal, 2 hot).

Output. z-like (unbounded), fractional deltas, per-60 rate; downstream probabilities 0-1

M-SUS-044 · Sustainability Sandbox band-status streaks, streak intensity and barometer pointer

Classify each snapshot as hot/cold/neutral against its trend band, build streak segments, and map the raw sustainability score onto a 0-100 barometer.

Method. status = hot if value > ciUpper, cold if value < ciLower, else neutral; consecutive same-status rows form a segment; segment intensity = min(1, 0.25 + 0.18*length); point opacity min(1, 0.4 + 0.12*streakLength); rolling line uses row.ewma, falling back to a client rollingAverage with window min(5, n); baseline = latest non-null band baseline else mean of values. Barometer = (clamp(rawScore, -3, 3) + 3)/6 * 100, 50 when missing.

Output. categorical status; intensity 0-1; barometer 0-100

BLSH (Buy Low / Sell High)

M-BLSH-001 · BLSH forecast development comparison (arms P0-P3, gamma transfer, cluster bootstrap)

Exploratory test of whether BLSH references predict next-5-game production.

Method. Origins: 5-game window + next 5 games in same season, gaps ≤30 days, no team change. P0 = mean of previous season's last 50 games; P1 = shrunk reference rate × window TOI/game; P1_H = rate × history TOI/game; P2_transfer = (rate + delta·beta/3600)·tau; P2 = rate shifted by gamma (no-intercept WLS of 3600·(next5 rate − reference rate) on ΔX, equal weight per player, ×0.5); P3 = window mean. FP/G+A floored 0. Composite weights a_t=(1/3)/sd_t/sqrt(w'Rw) from training targets. Paired MAE/RMSE differences with player cluster bootstrap (2000 draws, mulberry32 seed 20261029), 95% percentile CI. Decision: FP P2<P0 CI below 0, P2<P1 point, G+A and GS not worse.

Output. MAE/RMSE differences

M-BLSH-003 · BLSH opportunity split (per-game vs PP/non-PP-rate-adjusted comparison)

Tell whether a production gap is explained by ice-time / power-play role change.

Method. Weights normalised to Kish effective games n_eff; perGame mean and weighted SD. Split: PP point value = 3+goalShare for FP, 1 for G+A (GS not split); nonPpRate=(perGame*n_eff - value*PPP)/nonPP seconds; ppRate shrunk to cohort with pseudo-exposure k=3600 s ((value*PPP + k*cohortRate)/(pp+k)); personal-only if pp≥1800 s. (a) per-game: expected=n*perGame, scale=SD*sqrt(n); (b) adjusted: expected=r0*nonPP+r1*PP, scale=sqrt(n*residualSD^2 + PP^2*value*r1/ppExposure). z=gap/scale, |z|<0.5 balanced, z>0 sell_high, z<0 buy_low. Assessment matrix (agree/explains/withheld). Opportunity effect = (b)-(a) or ratePerSecond*ΔTOI. minGames 20.

Output. z; direction enum

M-BLSH-005 · BLSH stage 2b: position cohort production prior (donor moments, signal/noise covariance)

Estimate between-player signal covariance and per-second noise covariance of the 3 tracks from 50-game donor histories.

Method. Donors: same position, exactly 50 prior games, single position, excluding target. Per donor rate=Σy/Σt; residual cov from ten 5-game blocks Σ e_i e_j / t_b / 9. mu=mean donor rate; observedCov (n-1); omega=mean residual cov; noise=mean(omega/seconds); base=observedCov+noise; signal = PSD projection (eigen-clip) of (observedCov-noise) in standardised units; metric = pseudo-inverse of base (correlation eigen, tol eps). Needs ≥2 donors.

Output. covariance matrices

M-BLSH-013 · BLSH stage 4a: process-support sensitivity model (within-player beta, SHRINK 0.5)

Fit how 5-game changes in process (ixG/60, on-ice xGF/60, xGA/60) move production, on disjoint training blocks.

Method. Exclude target player, other positions, unqualified blocks, blocks with team/position change. Group by player-season (≥2 blocks). M-SKO-004 · sKO points prediction (moving-average blend with volatility penalty)

Predict a skater's points over the next N games and a sKO score penalised for recent volatility.

Method. avg5 = mean(last 5), avg10 = mean(last 10); recentBlend = 0.6*avg10 + 0.4*avg5; pred_points = recentBlend*horizon. stdevShort = population SD of last stabilityWindow games; stdevLong = SD of last 20; t1 = 0.8*stdevLong, t2 = max(t1+1e-6, 1.2*stdevLong); ratio = clamp((stdevShort-t1)/(t2-t1)); smooth = 3r^2-2r^3; multiplier = 0.8 + 0.2*(1-smooth) in [0.8,1]; sko = pred_points*multiplier. MODEL_VERSION v0.3.

Output. projected points over horizon (default 5 games); multiplier 0.8-1.0

M-TEAM-001 · matview team_power_ratings_daily__new (sql/001)

Daily team offense/defense/pace ratings via EWMA, shrinkage and z-scores, plus finishing/goalie/danger/special/discipline components

Method. params lookback 25 games, half-life 10 games, mode setting team_power_mode (all|5v5). pace = (CF60+CA60)/2. EWMA weight 0.5^(age/10) over last 25 games in season. Shrink: w = min(1, gp_to_date/10); metric = w*EWMA + (1-w)*league daily avg. z = (metric - daily league mean)/daily league stddev_samp. off_raw = 0.7 z_xGF + 0.2 z_SF + 0.1 z_GF; def_raw = 0.7(-z_xGA) + 0.2(-z_SA) + 0.1(-z_GA); ratings = 100 + 15*z-standardized raw. PP/PK tiers via percentile_cont 0.33/0.67 per date. trend = AVG(off_rating) prior 10 rows. extras (single-game, per date): finishing = GF60-xGF60, goaltending = xGA60-GA60, danger = HDCF/(HDCF+HDCA), PP xGF60, PK xGA60, discipline diff, PDO; each z per date; component rating = 100+15*z; special = 100+15*(0.20 z_pp_off + 0.20(-z_pk_def)); variance_flag if |z_pdo|>=1.

Output. 100-centred, SD-15 ratings; tiers 1-3

M-TEAM-011 · Team power ratings daily writer (PP/PK tiers and carry-forward)

M-UST-022 · Strength of schedule (direct + indirect opponent point %)

Past and future schedule strength per team for the ratings landing.

Method. Direct = opponents' combined point% = (2W + OTL)/(2*(W+L+OTL)). Indirect = games-weighted mean of each opponent's own direct value for the same bucket (opponents' opponents). M-UST-059 · Score-state classifier (score differential before event)

Bucket events/shots/segments into tied, leading, trailing, withinOne, upOne, downOne.

Method. diff = team score - opponent score before the event (goal events subtract the scoring goal). 0=tied, +1=upOne, -1=downOne, >=+2 'leading', <=-2 'trailing'; withinOne = |diff|<=1; allScores matches everything; null diff fails non-all states.

Output. bucket label / boolean

M-UST-060 · Team-relative strength-state classifier (shift/shot based)

Decide whether a shot/segment belongs to a requested strength split for a given team.

Method. EV = teamSkaters == opponentSkaters (no goalie check); 5v5 = both goalies in and 5 vs 5; PP = teamSkaters > oppSkaters; PK = teamSkaters < oppSkaters; 5v4PP/4v5PK/3v3 require both goalies in; withEmptyNet = own goalie pulled; againstEmptyNet = opponent goalie pulled. Skater split keys collapse 5v4PP/4v5PK/3v3/EN strengths to 'pk' for skaters (resolveSkaterSplitKey falls through to 'pk').

Output. boolean match / split key

Convert counts to per-60-minute rates.

GAA = GA*3600/TOI.

Output. per-60 rates (events per 60 minutes); GAA goals per 60

M-UST-080 · Heuristic approximate xG per shot

Assign an expected-goal value to each unblocked/blocked attempt for team and fallback individual xG.

Method. Hand-set lookup, not a trained model. Per shot: base 0.18 high / 0.08 medium / 0.02 low danger; +0.03 rebound, +0.02 rush, +0.02 royal-road crossing; if goal, value=max(value,0.25); cap 0.95; null if distance/angle missing. INCLUDES: x,y normalized to the attacking direction by mirroring (x,y)->(-x,-y) when the shooting team attacks the left side, from home_team_defending_side (web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlCoordinates.ts:51); net fixed at (89,0); distance = Euclidean feet to (89,0) (nhlShotFeatureBuilder.ts:182); angle = atan2(|dy|,|dx|) degrees (nhlShotFeatureBuilder.ts:192), used only through the danger buckets (<=20 ft & <=35 deg high; <=40 ft & <=50 deg medium; else low); rebound flag (DEFAULT_REBOUND_WINDOW_SECONDS=3, web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlRebounds.ts:6); rush flag (DEFAULT_RUSH_WINDOW_SECONDS=10, web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlRush.ts:5); royal-road crossing (prior and current event y of opposite sign, both x>=25, nhlContextualFeatures.ts:277); goal outcome (as a floor). EXCLUDES: shot type, distance/angle as continuous terms (bucketed only), strength state, score state/score effects, shooter talent, goalie effects, venue/rink scorer bias adjustment, time/period, empty-net handling, training set or seasons (none — constants are hand-set), model type (none; lookup table, not logistic/GBM), calibration to league goal rate (none). Blocked attempts are not excluded in team summaries (attempt type not checked before assigning xG). A copy of the same proxy is in nhlNstParityMetrics.ts:~410 (other slice).

Output. expected goals per shot, 0.02-0.95 (sum = goals)

Method. parseTime: if string contains '.', return Number(string) unchanged; else minutes = mm + ss/60. TOI% per game = TOI minutes*100/60. Team PP time per date = (sum of every current-roster player's PPTOI minutes on that date)/5; player PP share = player PPTOI / team PP time * 100. Callers convert parseTime output to seconds with *60.

Output. parseTime: decimal minutes; fetchTOIData TOI: percent of 60 minutes (0-100+, OT can exceed 100); PPTOI: percent 0-100 of estimated team PP time

M-ROLL-001 · Player trend rolling averages, running mean and variance

Per player per metric per game: raw value, cumulative mean, L3/L5/L10 rolling mean, sample variance and SD

Method. Accumulator per player+metric across ALL supplied history (no season reset; version 'full-history'). Null values skipped (not zero). average = sum/count; rolling_avg_k = simple mean of last k non-null values, null until k values; variance = (sumSq - sum^2/n)/(n-1), clamped >=0, null if n<2; SD = sqrt. Records emitted only from emitFromDate (7-day repair window).

Output. same units as input; rolling L3/L5/L10 simple means of non-null values; sample variance/SD; sample_size count

M-ROLL-003 · Skater trend percentile series with low-sample shrink

Rank skaters per trend category by percentile of their windowed value at each game number and compute rank movement.

Games played over team games available for season, 3YA, career and last N team games; split strengths report positive-TOI participation.

M-ROLL-010 · Legacy sKO characteristic-game classifier (z-scores, weighted chi-square thresholds, stat weights)

Label each game as Highly/Moderately/Uncharacteristic versus the player's prior games.

Method. Weights = normalized inverse of importance ratings (SH% 4.0625, IPP 4.8125, oiSH% 6.263, ZS% 6.583, TOI 4.692, PA/SA 6.571, SOG/60 4.0625, PPTOI% 4.667) -> sum to 1. For game i, baseline = mean and population SD (divide by n) over games 0..i-1; SD 0 -> 1. z capped at +/-5; per-stat label |z|<=1 Highly, <=2 Moderately, else Uncharacteristic. Score = sum w*z^2; T1 = sum w (=1), T2 = T1 + 2*sqrt(2*sum w^2) (chi-square-1 mean/variance approximation). PA/SA ratio: current game capped at 10 (SA=0 & PA>0 -> 10); prior games recomputed with Infinity for SA=0, then non-finite values filtered out of mean/SD. First game -> 'Insufficient History'.

Output. z-scores capped +/-5; weighted sum of squared z (>=0); T1=1, T2=1+2*sqrt(2*sum w^2); categorical labels

M-ROLL-024 · Social share Hot/Cold Recent Form (recent-form-v1-early)

Rank skaters whose points per game over their last 5 appearances rose or fell most versus the 5 appearances before.

Method. Active skater = strength 'all' row from this season with latest game within 7 days of the New York edition date and a known team; whole layer stale if newest row update > 72 h (PLAYER_STATS_MAX_AGE_MS). Qualifier: GP >= 10 and season points proven whole (|points_avg_season*GP - round| <= 0.01 and last10 <= season points). recent = last5/5, preceding = (last10-last5)/5 (both rounded 2 dp), delta = recent - preceding. Hot = delta>0 sorted delta desc, then recent desc, then id; Cold = delta<0 mirror. List 5 (+5 slack before name filter).

Output. points per game (2 dp) and delta in P/GP

M-ROLL-026 · Social share per-game series reconstruction from cumulative and window sums (sparklines)

Solve each of a skater's last 10 per-game values exactly from stored season-to-date totals and last-N window totals, then check them against the row's own L5.

Method. Ranges: season totals (games 1..n, total = avg_season*GP; points must round to an integer within 0.01) plus writer windows (n-N+1..n). Nested ranges sharing a start or end are subtracted into new ranges (<= 12 rounds, <= 400 ranges); a range with one unknown game solves it; points ranges with total 0 set all games 0. Points series rejected unless sums of last 5/10 equal stored totals; TOI series rejected if |mean of last 5 - toi_avg_last5| > 2 s; rate series per game = count/TOI*3600 and rejected if pooled L5 rate differs from stored L5 by > max(2% of L5, 0.05).

Output. per-game values (points, TOI seconds, per-60)

M-ROLL-028 · Player trend page: rolling-vs-baseline delta %, hot/cold streak and L7/L14/L30 quick cards

Client-side comparison of a player's rolling window value against a chosen baseline, streak labelling, and calendar-day recent averages on /trends/player/[playerId].

Method. absolute = rolling - baseline; delta% = (rolling - baseline)/|baseline|*100 (null when baseline 0). Streak: latest delta >= +8 -> hot, <= -8 -> cold, else steady; streak length = consecutive most-recent games with delta >= 0 (hot) or <= 0 (cold), a sign test rather than the 8% threshold; averageDelta = mean of all deltas; metrics sorted by |latestDelta|. Quick cards: Rolling10 uses the last10 field; L7/L14/L30 = unweighted mean of raw per-game values with game_date in [latest-(days-1), latest] (calendar days anchored to the player's last game, not today), then delta% vs baseline. Metric families: additive_average (goals, assists, points, shots, hits, blocks, pp_points) and weighted_rate per-60 metrics.

Output. delta in percent (unbounded, signed); streak length in games; recent value in source metric units

M-ROLL-040 · Legacy GP and _avg_/_total_ alias outputs and compatibility resolution

Keeps legacy column names populated and decides canonical vs legacy precedence for readers.

Method. For ratio and per-60 metrics, _avg_lastN and _total_lastN both equal the ratio-of-sums value (not a mean of per-game ratios). gp_pct_total_* and gp_pct_avg_* mirror the availability/participation ratios. Readers prefer canonical first for ratio/weighted_rate/availability families and legacy first for additive/TOI families.

Output. same as canonical metric (fraction 0-1 for gp_pct; percent/per-60 per metric)

M-ROLL-041 · Pipeline diagnostics: scale bounds, ratio re-check, source tail lag

Flag out-of-range outputs, GP ratio mismatches and stale source tails.

Method. Bounds: fractions 0-1 (gp_pct, availability_pct, primary_points_pct, expected_sh_pct, pp_share_pct), percents 0-100 (shooting_pct, ipp, oz_start_pct, on_ice_sh_pct, on_ice_sv_pct, cf_pct, ff_pct), PDO 0-2. GP checks: numerator <= denominator and |min(1, num/den) - stored| <= 1e-6. Tail lag = count of expected WGO dates (all) or split-source dates after the latest date in each NST table; PP lag counts WGO games with pp_toi > 0 after the latest builder game id; line lag counts WGO game ids after the latest line row.

Output. warning counts and lag counts (integers)

M-ROLL-042 · Validation recompute comparison and reconstruction helpers

Compare stored rows with a fresh recompute and reconstruct missing support values for the debug page.

Method. Diff = stored - recomputed; match if |diff| <= 1e-6; percentDiff = diff/|recomputed|*100. Missing per-60 numerator support for _total_ scopes rebuilt as rate * toi_seconds / 3600. Team PP TOI inferred = player PP TOI / share. Availability membership = last N team games of the focused team in the requested season; other metrics = last N stored rows. Readiness BLOCKED on any source tail lag or unknown game ids; mismatch cause bucket stale source / stale target / logic defect. Formula strings documented in METRIC_FORMULAS.

Output. absolute diff, percent diff (0-100), readiness label

M-ROLL-043 · Team game ledger, season-id derivation and appearance anchor

Per-team cumulative game index by date and per-row season assignment.

Method. Ledger: per team+season, sort games by date and number them 1..n; binary search gives games played through a date. Season: if WGO season_id disagrees with the date-derived season (startYear = year if month >= 9 else year-1; id = startYear*10001+1, e.g. 2024 -> 20242025) the date wins (fixes mislabelled 2010-2017 rows); else WGO season_id, NST counts season, rates season, or 0. Season window key = floor(season/10000).

Output. team game index 1..n; season id

M-ROLL-044 · Ratio-of-sums rolling/historical aggregation engine

Shared accumulator that computes every ratio and per-60 metric from summed numerator/denominator components over last-N, all-processed, season, 3-year and career scopes.

Method. Value = (sum num / sum den) * scale, optionally + (sum num2 / sum den2) * scale ('sum' combine, used by PDO), then * outputScale, rounded to 6 dp. Never averages per-game ratios. Windows 3/5/10/20 (CANONICAL_ROLLING_GAME_WINDOWS) are FIFO queues of the last N slots. For ratio_performance and weighted_rate_performance families the window mode is 'appearance': a slot is consumed only when anchor=true (all-strength: every WGO row; split strengths: TOI>0), and a slot with missing/invalid components still occupies the slot but adds nothing. A missing numerator beside a present denominator drops the components (explicit 0 still counts). No denominator -> null or 0 per spec. Historical buckets are keyed by season and are NOT anchor-gated; 3YA = seasons with startYear in [current-2, current]; career = every season bucket read.

Output. depends on spec: scale 3600 -> per-60 rate; scale 100 -> percent 0-100; scale 1 -> fraction 0-1; PDO sum*0.01 -> index ~1.0 (0-2). Ratio of sums, never mean of ratios; rounded 6 dp

M-ROLL-045 · Rolling window contracts and metric-to-family map

Declares what 'last N' means and which aggregation each metric family uses.

Method. Four families: availability (current team's last N chronological team games), additive_performance (sum and mean over the player's last N appearances with a defined value), ratio_performance (ratio of aggregated components over last N appearances in the strength state), weighted_rate_performance (sum events / sum TOI over last N appearances). Windows fixed at 3, 5, 10, 20. Mapping: per-60s -> weighted_rate; shooting_pct, primary_points_pct, expected_sh_pct, ipp, oz_start_pct, pp_share_pct, on_ice_sh_pct, pdo, cf_pct, ff_pct -> ratio; counts, ixg, iscf, ihdcf, toi_seconds, pp_toi_seconds -> additive.

Output. categorical family label

NST-derived stats

M-NST-001 · On-ice percentages and PDO

Compute CF%, FF%, SF%, GF%, xGF%, SCF%, HDCF%, HDGF%, MDCF%, MDGF%, LDCF%, LDGF%, oiSH%, oiSV%, PDO.

Method. X% = For/(For+Against)*100 (null if denom<=0). oiSH% = GF/SF*100; oiSV% = (SA-GA)/SA*100; PDO = oiSH% + oiSV% (scale ~200, percent units 0-100).

Output. percent 0-100 (PDO ~ 200 scale); per single game

M-NST-005 · Approximate xG fallback heuristic

Assign an xG value per shot attempt when no model xG is attached.

Method. Base 0.18 high / 0.08 medium / 0.02 low; +0.03 rebound, +0.02 rush, +0.02 royal-road; if the shot is a goal, value = max(value, 0.25); cap 0.95. Applied to every shot attempt type including blocked and missed. XG INCLUDES (fallback heuristic): shot x,y mirrored to attacking direction by event-owner side and homeTeamDefendingSide, net at (89,0) ft; distance (ft) and angle (deg, |dy|/|89-x|) only via danger bucket cut-offs (<=20ft&<=35deg high, <=40ft&<=50deg medium); rebound flag (3 s, same team, immediate prior SOG/miss/block); rush flag (10 s backward scan, D/N-zone takeaway/faceoff win/opp giveaway/opp block); royal-road flag; goal outcome floor 0.25. XG EXCLUDES: shot type, strength state, score state, empty-net adjustment, shooter effects, goalie effects, any trained model or training set/seasons (hand-set constants), calibration (excluded). The trained model (scripts/train-nhl-xg-baseline.ts) is NOT wired into this path in production.

Output. xG per attempt, probability-like 0.02-0.95 (summed to xGF/xGA in goals)

M-NST-006 · NST radar season values (on-ice shares, per-60 rates, league sample minima)

Compute a skater's season value and the league comparison values for the /stats/player radar from NST all-strength season views.

Method. On-ice shares = for/(for+against)*100 (0-100 scale) for CF%, FF%, SF%, GF%, xGF% (ratio of season sums from NST counts). Per-60 rates are taken as stored NST values (not recomputed) except hdca_per_60 = hdca*3600/toi_seconds_oi. League rows must clear minima: CF+CA>=20, FF+FA>=15, SF+SA>=10, GF+GA>=1, xGF+xGA>=1, toi_seconds>=3600 (1 h) for rates, toi_seconds_oi>=3600 for HDCA/60; player row is NOT filtered. Consumer percentile = round(#league values strictly worse / N * 100); rank = #strictly better + 1; inverted for 'isInverted' stats and GAA.

Output. on-ice shares 0-100 (percent points, ratio of season sums); per-60 rates; consumer percentile integer 0-100 (exclusive of ties), rank 1..N

M-NST-008 · Score-state context features (running score, game-time segments)

Per-event pre-event score, owner score differential buckets and late-game flags for shot features.

M-NST-009 · Contextual shot features (shift age, PP age, movement, royal road)

Per-shot shooter/team shift ages, previous shift gaps/durations, power-play age, east-west/north-south movement and royal-road crossing.

Method. Shift age = event period second - active shift start; previous gap/duration from player's prior shift; owner/opponent averages and max over on-ice players. PP age = seconds since the team's current PP segment started (restarts if strength_exact changes). Movement (same-team prior event only): east-west = |dy|, north-south = dx. Royal road crossed if both x>=25 and y sign flips (non-zero). XG ROLE: INCLUDES shooter shift age, owner PP age, east-west/north-south movement and royal-road crossing (x>=25 ft both events, y sign flip) as model features; EXCLUDES opponent PP age, owner/opponent average shift age and previous-shift gaps from first_pass_v1 (computed but unused there), pre-shot passes (not in NHL PbP).

Output. seconds; feet; boolean

M-NST-013 · Rebound detection and rebound control outcome

Flag rebound shots and classify what each source shot produced.

Method. Rebound shot = shot-feature-eligible attempt whose immediately previous event (same period, same owner team) is a SOG/missed/blocked shot within 0<dt<=3 s. Also distance from source, lateral displacement |dy|, distance delta and |angle change|. Source outcome: has rebound target -> second_chance_allowed; SOG followed by stoppage within 3 s -> goalie_freeze/covered puck; else no_danger_continuation. XG ROLE: rebound definition = time window 3 s, immediate prior event only, same team, same period; NO distance window (excluded); rebound distance/angle-change are recorded but not used by first_pass_v1; fallback xG adds +0.03.

Output. booleans; deltas in feet/degrees; categorical outcome

M-NST-014 · Rush shot detection

Flag rush attempts from transition events in the neutral/defensive zone.

Non-rebound eligible attempt; scan back up to 10 s in same period; qualifying source = own takeaway, own faceoff win, opponent giveaway, opponent blocked shot, located in team-relative D or N zone. M-NST-015 · Coordinate normalization, shot distance and angle

Mirror raw rink coordinates to the attacking direction and compute distance/angle to the net at (89,0).

Method. Attacking side: home attacks opposite its defending side, away attacks the home defending side. If attacking 'left', negate x and y. Distance = sqrt((89-x)^2 + (0-y)^2) ft; angle = atan2(|y|, |89-x|) in degrees (0 = straight on). XG ROLE: x,y mirrored only when the owner attacks 'left' (both x and y negated); net fixed at (89,0); no rink-bias/scorekeeper adjustment (excluded); distance and angle are both trained-model features and fallback-bucket inputs.

M-NST-016 · Strength segments and TOI by split (skater and goalie)

Derive per-player TOI (seconds) for each strength split by overlapping shift intervals with event-to-event strength segments.

Method. Segments run from each included event's period_seconds_elapsed to the next included event's time in the same period (last segment ends at period_duration_seconds); each carries its situation and score. For each shift interval, overlap = min(end)-max(start) with each segment of the same game/period; overlap seconds added to every split the segment matches. 'all' TOI uses full shift durationSeconds when scoreState=allScores, otherwise only overlapped seconds passing the score filter. Goalie TOI same, restricted to goalieIds (goalies seen as goalieInNetId on shots).

Output. TOI in SECONDS per player per split (not minutes)

M-NST-020 · Goalie parity counts, SV%, GAA and 'GSAA'

Compute goalie shots against, saves, GA, SV%, GAA, xGA, GSAA, HD/MD/LD SV% and GAA, rush/rebound attempts against, average shot/goal distance.

Method. Goalie team = team opposite event owner. SA/saves from goal+SOG excluding own goals; GA counts all goals incl. own goals. SV% = saves/SA*100. GAA = GA*3600/TOI. xg_against = sum of approximate xG for all non-own-goal attempts. gsaa = xg_against - GA. HD SV% = hd_saves/hd_SA*100; hd_gaa = (hd_SA - hd_saves)*3600/TOI; md/ld analogous; hd/md/ld_gsaa hard-coded null. avg distances = mean shot/goal distance in feet. Per-60 versions via toPer60 including gsaa_per_60. XG INCLUDES (fallback heuristic): shot x,y mirrored to attacking direction by event-owner side and homeTeamDefendingSide, net at (89,0) ft; distance (ft) and angle (deg, |dy|/|89-x|) only via danger bucket cut-offs (<=20ft&<=35deg high, <=40ft&<=50deg medium); rebound flag (3 s, same team, immediate prior SOG/miss/block); rush flag (10 s backward scan, D/N-zone takeaway/faceoff win/opp giveaway/opp block); royal-road flag; goal outcome floor 0.25. XG EXCLUDES: shot type, strength state, score state, empty-net adjustment, shooter effects, goalie effects, any trained model or training set/seasons (hand-set constants), calibration (excluded). The trained model (scripts/train-nhl-xg-baseline.ts) is NOT wired into this path in production.

Output. SV% percent 0-100; GAA per 60 (per 3600 s); gsaa in goals (xGA-GA); avg distance feet

M-NST-027 · NST rate-limit admission window math (local ledger + shared RPC + Python admission)

Decide when the next NST request may start so the rolling 1m/5m/15m/1h windows and 21 s spacing are never exceeded across callers.

Method. Windows: 1m max 39, 5m max 80, 15m max 100, 1h max 180; min spacing 21,000 ms. Local ledger: drop inactive attempts older than 1 h; wait = max(100 ms if same URL in flight, last.startedAt + max(last.intervalMs, intervalMs) - now, for each window with count>=max: the (count-max)-th oldest startedAt + windowMs + 1 - now). Interval = 0 only when minIntervalMs==0 AND plannedRequestCount is a safe integer 1..78 (semi-burst, 'two 39-attempt waves'); else max(21000, minIntervalMs). Every network attempt (incl. retries) counts. Shared RPC: POST with p_burst/p_planned_requests; if allowed, permit must be used within permitTtlMs=1000 ms measured from before the POST; if denied sleep max(25 ms, waitMs). Python mirror: same receipt checks, burst iff min_interval_ms==0 and 1<=planned_requests<=78, default min_interval_ms 21000, default deadline now+220 s, sleep max(0.025 s, waitMs/1000). Static plan check: projected requests in a window at fixed cadence = min(n, floor(window/interval)+1).

Output. wait time in ms (>=0) or permit/deny; ledger counts per window 0..39/80/100/180

Splits: ev = teamState EV; fiveOnFive = both goalies in and 5v5 skaters; pp = PP; pk = SH; fiveOnFourPP/fourOnFivePK require goalies in and exact 5v4/4v5; threeOnThree = goalies in and 3v3; withEmptyNet = own goalie 0; againstEmptyNet = opponent goalie 0. An event can belong to several splits; 'all' always added.

Output. categorical split keys; strength_state EV/PP/SH/EN; strength_exact 'awayvhome'

M-CARD-007 · Player-card pooled NST metric (ATOI, per-60, percentage)

Pool a player's selected appearance-window NST game rows into 12 card metrics using ratio-of-sums

Method. Per metric: sum numerator components and denominator components over all selected games (ratio of sums). atoi = sum(individual.toi sec)/GP/60 (min/GP); per60 = 3600*sum(num)/sum(TOI sec) (individual metrics use individual.toi, on-ice metrics cf60/scf60/xgf60 use onIce.toi); percentage = 100*sum(num)/sum(den): xG% = xgf/(xgf+xga), IPP = total_points/onIce.gf, SH% = goals/shots, oiSH% = onIce.gf/onIce.sf. Per-game validation: any negative/missing component -> missing; per60 with zero TOI but events>0 -> missing; percentage num>den -> missing; pooled zero denominator -> state 'undefined'.

Output. atoi minutes per GP; per-60 rates (events*3600/TOI sec); percentages 0-100 (xG%, IPP, SH%, oiSH%); ratio-of-sums across games

M-LINE-016 · Social share deployment change (TOI/GP L5 vs season, line and PP unit step)

Classify skaters as deployment up/down from TOI change and line/PP-unit moves between the last two contiguous games.

Method. Qualifier GP >= 10. TOI delta = round(L5 avg TOI s) - round(season avg TOI s). Driver = 'toi' if |delta| >= 60 s (direction = sign), else 'role' (requires a line or PP change, mixed signs dropped; direction = sign of lineChange+ppChange). M-WIGO-005 · WiGO player ratings (offense/defense/overall by strength)

Weighted composite of stat percentiles per strength (AS/ES/PP/PK) into 0-100 offense, defense and overall ratings.

Method. Per stat percentile (x100) vs cohort with gp >= cohortMinGp; withheld if < 20 peers (WIGO_RATING_MIN_COHORT_PEERS). If player GP < 10 at that strength: regressed = (GP*pct + (10-GP)*mean pct of peers with GP>=10)/10, clamped 0-100. Offense weights AS/ES: P/60 25, ixG/60 20, SOG/60 15, iSCF/60 10, iHDCF/60 10, xGF% 10, CF% 5, PEND/60 5; defense AS/ES: xGA/60 30, SCA/60 20, HDCA/60 15, BLK/60 10, TK/60 10, minor pen/60 5, GV/60 10 (lower better where noted); PP offense: GF/60 25, xGF/60 20, P/60 15, SCF/60 10, SOG/60 15, HDGF/60 10, PEND/60 5; PK defense: GA/60 25, xGA/60 20, SCA/60 15, SA/60 10, HDCA/60 10, BLK/60 10, TK/60 5. Rating = weighted mean of available percentiles. overall.as/es = mean(off,def); overall.st = PP-off and PK-def weighted by PP/PK TOI; final = mean(as, es, st).

Output. 0-100 rating

M-GST-006 · FORGE starter probability model (computeStarterProbabilities)

Score each candidate goalie and convert to start probabilities (sigmoid for 2, softmax for 3).

Method. score = 2.4*(L10share-0.5) + 0.7*logit(prior clamp .01-.99) + 0.45*logit(lineCombo prior clamp .05-.95) + 0.5*clamp(GSAA60,+-0.6) + 0.28*(seasonStart%-0.5)*GP/(GP+10) + 0.2*GP/(GP+10); B2B: starter of previous game -2.75, other goalie +0.65; B2B & team weaker (GF + 0.35 < opp GF): primary (L10share>=0.6) -1.1, backup +0.45; weak opponent (GF <= 2.6): primary -0.7, backup +0.3; rust: >75 d -6, >30 d -3, >14 d -0.8, <=7 d +0.2. Two candidates: p = clamp(sigmoid(diff), .02, .98); three: softmax clamped .01-.98 (not renormalized). One candidate -> 1.

M-DRF-012 · Community draft rankings: regularized Bradley-Terry with ADP prior

Aggregate users' pairwise preferences into a public community top-250.

Method. Scores s_i, prior mean m_i = ln((F+1-r)/r) for market rank r (F = field size), 0 if unranked. Market prior weight = 4*max(0, 1-independentUsers/20). Objective: Bradley-Terry log-likelihood with P(i beats j)=sigmoid(s_i-s_j) - 0.25/2*s^2 (L2) - w_i/2*(s_i-m_i)^2. Diagonal (Jacobi) Newton: delta = clamp(0.5*grad/curvature, +/-1), up to 500 iters, tol 1e-8; must converge. Evidence states: emerging (>=5 users, >=10 comparisons, >=5 opponents), established (>=20 users, >=40 comparisons, >=10 opponents, >=2 opponents ranked 200-250 and >=2 ranked 251-300). stabilityBuffer = ceil(30/sqrt(users)+40/sqrt(comparisons)+10/sqrt(opponents)) (75 with no comparisons); conservativeRank = modelRank + buffer. Public top-250: market rank <=250 and not established (market prior), OR established and conservativeRank <= 250; renumbered 1..250 by model rank. rank_delta = previousPublicRank - publicRank.

Output. latent score (log-odds scale); ranks 1..N; public rank 1..250

M-DRF-019 · buildPositionTiers / advisePosition: 1-D k-means positional tiers + take-now advice

Automatic value tiers per position and Take now / Can wait advice.

Method. Values min-max scaled to 0..1; exact contiguous 1-D k-means (DP on prefix sums), k=2..min(8,unique,n-1), best k by mean silhouette (neighbour-group 1-D silhouette); n<4 -> one band. Then recursively split any band wider than 0.05 of the scaled range at its min-SSE boundary. Tied values never split. breakThreshold = max(3*median adjacent gap, 0.25*IQR). Remaining band gap = last remaining in band minus first remaining in next non-empty band; meaningfulBreak if gap > breakThreshold. Advice: expected = sum availability over remaining band players; 'Can wait' if opposingPicks=0 or expected>=1.5 (and gap known); 'Take now' if expected<0.5 and meaningfulBreak. Tier adapter nulls values whose required inputs (SV% needs SA>0, GAA needs starts) are incomplete.

Output. tier index 1..N; expected remaining count (players)

M-DRF-027 · useVORPCalculations: VORP / VOLS / VONA / VBD per player

Compute league-wide draft value over replacement (VORP), over last starter (VOLS), over next available (VONA) and the blended VBD rank value for every projected player.

Method. (1) REPLACEMENT LEVEL: per roster position p (C/LW/RW/D/G, or FWD/D/G when grouped; +FWD pool when rosterConfig.FWD>0) with T=teamCount and starters s_p (minus my filled slots when personalizeReplacement): VORP index = floor(T*(s_p + utilAdj_p) + 1) - 1 = T*(s_p+utilAdj_p) (0-based, i.e. the first player beyond league starters); VOLS index = floor(T*s_p) - 1 (the last league starter). UTIL slots are split 1/3 each to C/LW/RW (UTIL_TO_DEF_ENABLED=false so D gets 0); in 'fwd' grouping UTIL goes wholly to FWD. Bench slots are NOT counted (not handled). Goalies get no UTIL share. Replacement pool = remaining (available) players by default or full pool when baselineMode='full'; index clamped to pool length-1; empty pool -> replacement 0. (2) VALUE SOURCE: buildPlayerValues -> points leagues: projected fantasy points (source-weighted projection x league scoring; optional 84-game proration for skaters); categories leagues: sum of weighted z-scores from calculateCategoryScores. Optional Draft Pro position weight multiplier (0..2) applied to the value before pools. (3) VONA: N = floor(picksUntilNext); take the N available players with lowest Yahoo ADP (players without ADP ignored); each contributes 1/k to each of its k eligible positions -> expectedTaken_p. Baseline = value at index floor(currentIndexOfPlayerInAvailablePool_p + expectedTaken_p) in that position's available pool (or index floor(expectedTaken_p) if the player is not in the pool); VONA = value - baseline. Assumes opponents draft strictly by ADP; ignores opponent roster needs. (4) VBD = 0.6*VORP + 0.3*VONA + 0.1*VOLS (dashboard-specific blend; classic VBD uses one baseline). (5) MULTI-POSITION: eligibility normalized (F/FWD -> C,LW,RW); a player appears in every eligible pool; reported metrics come from the eligible position with max VORP (ties broken by VONA then VOLS) - not summed. Positional scarcity enters only through per-position replacement depth.

Output. VORP/VOLS/VONA/VBD in same units as value (fantasy points or z-score sum), unbounded, can be negative

Personalize suggestion order by roster and category needs without changing league VORP.

Method. (1) Replacement: not recomputed (uses candidate.rankValue/baselineScore). (2) Value source: rankScore = baselineScore ?? rankValue. Category values recomputed: SV% = saves/(saves+GA or SA), GAA = GA*3600/TOTAL_TOI (TOI in seconds); per-category z-scores via calculateCategoryScores over the CANDIDATE pool. (3) No VONA logic here; availability = estimatePlayerAvailability (reason tag only, not in score). (4) Position fit = max(clamp01(need_p)) over eligible positions. Category fit = sum(z_k * need_k)/sum(|need_k|*|w_k|) over enabled role-applicable categories; categories add position fit. normalizedFit = clamp01(fit / max(1, max|fit|)). recommendationScore = rankScore + alpha * normalizedFit * adjustmentScale, adjustmentScale = max(1, max |rankScore| over all candidates). (5) Multi-position: best eligible position need.

Output. recommendation score in rank-value units

M-DRF-030 · estimatePlayerAvailability: ADP normal-survival availability probability

Probability a player is still available at the user's target pick, conditional on being available now.

Method. Player draft slot ~ Normal(ADP, sd). now = (currentPick-1-ADP)/sd; later = (currentPick-1+opposingPicks-ADP)/sd. P = S(later)/S(now) with S = upper-tail normal survival via Abramowitz-Stegun 26.2.17 polynomial in log space (constants 0.2316419, 0.31938153, -0.356563782, 1.781477937, -1.821255978, 1.330274429). opposingPicks=0 -> 1. Clamped 0..1.

Output. probability 0-1

M-DRF-033 · calculateCategoryScores: weighted category z-score composite with goalie rate shrinkage

Convert projected category stats to one comparable value for categories leagues.

Method. Per role (skater/goalie) and category: mean and SAMPLE std dev (n-1) over every player in the supplied pool with a finite value. Goalie SV% shrunk: (SA*sv + 1200*mean)/(SA+1200) (PRIOR_SHOTS=1200); GAA shrunk: (GS*gaa + 25*mean)/(GS+25) (PRIOR_STARTS=25). z = (value-mean)/sd, inverted for GAA, GOALS_AGAINST_GOALIE, LOSSES_GOALIE. Score = sum weight_k * z_k (weight defaults to 1 if non-finite). GAMES_PLAYED and TOTAL_TOI apply to both roles. Categories with sd=0 or missing values contribute 0.

Output. dimensionless weighted z-score sum (unbounded, ~0 mean)

M-DRF-034 · Mock draft roster feasibility (Dinic max-flow)

Check that every team can still fill all roster slots from held plus remaining players, so the bot or user pick never makes the draft infeasible.

Method. Quick reject if held + available < teamCount × slots. Flow network: source → player groups (key = seat + sorted positions, capacity = group count) → (seat, slot type) nodes (capacity = slot count) → sink. Held groups connect only to their own seat; free players (seat −1) connect to any seat. Dinic max-flow (BFS levels plus DFS augment). Held players must all route (flow = held count); then free players are added to the residual graph and total flow must equal teamCount × slots.

Output. boolean

Stats helpers

M-HLP-001 · Generic projection math primitives (decayBlend, ewsd, slope, shrinkage, poissonMeanFromRate, selectCountDistribution, clip, goalieFinishMult)

Reusable EWMA/shrinkage/Poisson-NB/clip helpers for projections.

Method. decayBlend: weights exp(-daysAgo/tau) x optional multiplier; mean = sum(w v)/sum w; nEff = (sum w)^2/sum w^2. ewsd: weighted population SD. slope: OLS slope vs observation index. shrinkage: nEff/(nEff+k)*recent + k/(nEff+k)*prior. poissonMean = rate/60 * TOI minutes * multiplier. selectCountDistribution: NB if Fano = var/mean > 1.25 with r = mean^2/(var-mean), else Poisson. goalieFinishMult = clip(1 - (svProj - leagueSv)/0.070, 0.80, 1.20).

Output. same units as input; multiplier 0.8-1.2

M-MISC-007 · NST career / 3-year averages (counts and rates) with multi-team TOT rows

Three-year and career averages of NST individual + on-ice stats.

Method. parseTime: TOI float minutes -> seconds. Multi-team seasons: sum aggregateKeys into TOT then recompute derived. Counts TOT: S%=G/SOG, secA%=A2/A, oZS%=oZS/(oZS+dZS), SOG/60 = SOG/TOI*60, oiSH%=oiGF/SF, IPP=(G+A)/oiGF, GF%/CF%/FF%/SF%/SCF%/xGF% = F/(F+A). Seasons = last 3 excluding current (3-year; error if <3) or all (career); counts summed and divided by 3 or N seasons; derived recomputed from averaged counts. Rates TOT: per-60 values SUMMED across teams then (sum / TOI_seconds)*3600; rate averages = simple mean of season per-60 values (divisor 3 or N); percentages from averaged rates.

Output. per-season averages; fractions 0-1; per-60 (buggy)

Projected requests per window = min(count, floor(window/interval)+1) (all at once if interval 0); windows 1m<=39, 5m<=80, 15m<=100, 1h<=180; compliant also requires count<=39 or interval>=21 s. Semi-burst eligible if <=78 (two 39-waves). Token constants: 10 tokens/page, 1800 standard cap, 150 refresh, 800 burst cap. Cron jobs spaced >=10 min (NST_MIN_CRON_BURST_GAP_MS).

Output. boolean + projected counts

Rank teams/players for streaming by GameGrid calcWeekScore and off-nights.

M-MISC-043 · Hot/cold streak rules

Flag L5 hot/cold streaks on share cards.

Method. Pre-L5 baseline = (season total - L5 total)/(GP-5). Hot: >=4/5 point games, >=0.85 P/GP, TOI >= +15% vs pre-L5 (>=3 pre games), PP TOI >= +35% (pre >= 30 s); specialists also HIT>2, BLK>2, SOG>2.5, PPP>0.5 per game. Cold mirrors (<=1/5, <=0.25 P/GP, -15%, -35%). Goalies hot QS>=4/5 or SV%>=.930; cold QS<=1 or SV%<=.870. Needs 5 recent games.
